content.arguments: {"code":"const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); let denied = false; try { await fs.writeFile('ptc-denied.txt', 'forbidden') } catch (error) { denied = ['EPERM', 'EACCES', 'EROFS'].includes(error.code) }; const shell = await tools.bash({ command: 'pwd', description: 'Report the current workspace directory' }); inspect({ denied, emptyEnvironment: Object.keys(process.env).length === 0, sameWorkspace: process.cwd() === shell.stdout.text.trim() }); return;","description":"Verify Node file policy and execution context"}
